draft.title: Mustard Slaw
draft.description: This coleslaw recipe from Steven Raichlen is dressed with mustard, vinegar, and hot sauce for a bright, punchy flavor
draft.nutrition_text: Calories: 100 kcal · Fat: 5 g · Saturated fat: 0 g · Unsaturated fat: 0 g · Cholesterol: 0 mg · Sodium: 193 mg · Carbohydrates: 13 g · Fiber: 3 g · Sugar: 8 g · Protein: 2 g
ingredients: 1 large head green cabbage, cored and finely chopped (about 10 cups)
steps: Whisk mustard with sugar in a very large bowl. Gradually whisk in vinegar, vegetable oil, hot sauce, and celery seeds. Season with salt and pepper; dressing should be highly seasoned. Add cabbage and carrots to the dressing and toss thoroughly.
